name: Andrew McLachlan I will now deal with the Migration Amendment Bill 2024 and two other bills, starting with the second reading amendments. The question is that the Pauline Hanson's One Nation amendment on sheet 2619 be agreed to. _Pauline Hanson's One Nation's circulated amendment_ _in respect of the_ _Migration Amendment_ _(Removal and Other Measures)_ _Bill 2024_ At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate notes that this bill does not: (a) solve the problem of removing non-citizens from immigration detention and deporting them or removing non-citizens who have no valid reason for remaining in Australia; or (b) actually enforce deportation, it only swaps detention centres for jail".
